verses.text_en: Woe be unto thee, Babylon, and Asia! woe be unto thee, Egypt and Syria!
verses.text_hr: Teško tebi, Babilone i Azijo! Teško tebi, Egipte i Sirijo!

verses.text_en: Gird up yourselves with cloths of sack and hair, bewail your children, and be sorry; for your destruction is at hand.
verses.text_hr: Opašite se kostrijeću i vrećama, oplakujte svoju djecu i tugujte, jer vam je propast blizu.

verses.text_en: A sword is sent upon you, and who may turn it back?
verses.text_hr: Mač je poslan na vas, a tko ga može vratiti?

verses.text_en: A fire is sent among you, and who may quench it?
verses.text_hr: Vatra je među vas poslana, a tko će je ugasiti?

verses.text_en: Plagues are sent unto you, and what is he that may drive them away?
verses.text_hr: Kuge su vam poslane, a tko ih može otjerati?

verses.text_en: May any man drive away an hungry lion in the wood? or may any one quench the fire in stubble, when it hath begun to burn?
verses.text_hr: Može li itko otjerati gladna lava iz šume? Može li tko ugasiti oganj u strnjici kad se razbukta?

verses.text_en: May one turn again the arrow that is shot of a strong archer?
verses.text_hr: Može li se vratiti strijela koju je odapeo snažan strijelac?

verses.text_en: The mighty Lord sendeth the plagues and who is he that can drive them away?
verses.text_hr: Silni Gospodin šalje pošasti; tko ih može otjerati?

verses.text_en: A fire shall go forth from his wrath, and who is he that may quench it?
verses.text_hr: Vatra će izaći iz njegova gnjeva, a tko je taj da je može ugasiti?

verses.text_en: He shall cast lightnings, and who shall not fear? he shall thunder, and who shall not be afraid?
verses.text_hr: On će bacati munje, a tko se neće bojati? On će grmjeti, a tko se neće bojati?

verses.text_en: The Lord shall threaten, and who shall not be utterly beaten to powder at his presence?
verses.text_hr: Gospodin će zaprijetiti; tko pred njim neće biti posve smrvljen?

verses.text_en: The earth quaketh, and the foundations thereof; the sea ariseth up with waves from the deep, and the waves of it are troubled, and the fishes thereof also, before the Lord, and before the glory of his power:
verses.text_hr: Zemlja se trese zajedno sa svojim temeljima; more se uzdiže valovima iz dubine, a njegovi se valovi i ribe uznemiruju pred Gospodinom i slavom njegove moći.

verses.text_en: For strong is his right hand that bendeth the bow, his arrows that he shooteth are sharp, and shall not miss, when they begin to be shot into the ends of the world.
verses.text_hr: Snažna je njegova desnica koja napinje luk; oštre su strijele koje odapinje i neće promašiti kad budu odaslane do krajeva svijeta.

verses.text_en: Behold, the plagues are sent, and shall not return again, until they come upon the earth.
verses.text_hr: Gle, pošasti su poslane i neće se vratiti prije nego što stignu na zemlju.

verses.text_en: The fire is kindled, and shall not be put out, till it consume the foundation of the earth.
verses.text_hr: Vatra je zapaljena i neće se ugasiti dok ne proguta temelje zemlje.

verses.text_en: Like as an arrow which is shot of a mighty archer returneth not backward: even so the plagues that shall be sent upon earth shall not return again.
verses.text_hr: Kao što se strijela koju odapne snažan strijelac ne vraća, tako se neće vratiti ni pošasti poslane na zemlju.

verses.text_en: Woe is me! woe is me! who will deliver me in those days?
verses.text_hr: Jao meni! Jao meni! Tko će me izbaviti u one dane?

verses.text_en: The beginning of sorrows and great mournings; the beginning of famine and great death; the beginning of wars, and the powers shall stand in fear; the beginning of evils! what shall I do when these evils shall come?
verses.text_hr: Početak boli i silnoga tugovanja; početak gladi i velike smrtnosti; početak ratova, kada će moćnici stajati u strahu; početak zala! Što ću učiniti kad ta zla dođu?

verses.text_en: Behold, famine and plague, tribulation and anguish, are sent as scourges for amendment.
verses.text_hr: Gle, glad i pošast, nevolja i tjeskoba poslani su kao bičevi radi popravka.

verses.text_en: But for all these things they shall not turn from their wickedness, nor be always mindful of the scourges.
verses.text_hr: Ali uza sve to neće se odvratiti od svoje opačine niti će se trajno sjećati bičeva.

verses.text_en: Behold, victuals shall be so good cheap upon earth, that they shall think themselves to be in good case, and even then shall evils grow upon earth, sword, famine, and great confusion.
verses.text_hr: Gle, namirnice će na zemlji biti tako jeftine da će ljudi misliti kako im je dobro; upravo će tada na zemlji bujati zla: mač, glad i velik metež.

verses.text_en: For many of them that dwell upon earth shall perish of famine; and the other, that escape the hunger, shall the sword destroy.
verses.text_hr: Jer mnogi od onih koji žive na zemlji izginut će od gladi; a one druge, koji umaknu gladi, uništit će mač.

verses.text_en: And the dead shall be cast out as dung, and there shall be no man to comfort them: for the earth shall be wasted, and the cities shall be cast down.
verses.text_hr: Mrtvi će biti izbačeni poput nečisti i neće biti nikoga da ih oplakuje; zemlja će biti opustošena, a gradovi porušeni.

verses.text_en: There shall be no man left to till the earth, and to sow it
verses.text_hr: Neće ostati nitko da obrađuje zemlju i sije je.

verses.text_en: The trees shall give fruit, and who shall gather them?
verses.text_hr: Stabla će rod davati, a tko će ih brati?

verses.text_en: The grapes shall ripen, and who shall tread them? for all places shall be desolate of men:
verses.text_hr: Grožđe će sazreti, a tko će ga gaziti? Sva će mjesta ostati bez ljudi.

verses.text_en: So that one man shall desire to see another, and to hear his voice.
verses.text_hr: Tako da će jedan čovjek poželjeti vidjeti drugoga i čuti njegov glas.

verses.text_en: For of a city there shall be ten left, and two of the field, which shall hide themselves in the thick groves, and in the clefts of the rocks.
verses.text_hr: Od jednoga grada ostat će deset ljudi, a iz polja dvojica; skrivat će se u gustim šumarcima i pukotinama stijena.

verses.text_en: As in an orchard of Olives upon every tree there are left three or four olives;
verses.text_hr: Kao u voćnjaku maslina, na svakom stablu ostaju tri ili četiri masline;

verses.text_en: Or as when a vineyard is gathered, there are left some clusters of them that diligently seek through the vineyard:
verses.text_hr: Ili kao kad se obere vinograd, pa onima koji ga pomno pretražuju ostane nekoliko grozdova,

verses.text_en: Even so in those days there shall be three or four left by them that search their houses with the sword.
verses.text_hr: Tako će u one dane ostati trojica ili četvorica nakon što im kuće mačem pretraže.

verses.text_en: And the earth shall be laid waste, and the fields thereof shall wax old, and her ways and all her paths shall grow full of thorns, because no man shall travel therethrough.
verses.text_hr: Zemlja će biti opustošena, njezina će polja ostarjeti, a putovi i sve staze obrasti trnjem jer nitko njima neće prolaziti.

verses.text_en: The virgins shall mourn, having no bridegrooms; the women shall mourn, having no husbands; their daughters shall mourn, having no helpers.
verses.text_hr: Djevice će tugovati jer neće imati zaručnika; žene će tugovati jer neće imati muževa, a njihove kćeri jer neće imati pomoćnika.

verses.text_en: In the wars shall their bridegrooms be destroyed, and their husbands shall perish of famine.
verses.text_hr: Njihovi će zaručnici biti pogubljeni u ratovima, a muževi će im umrijeti od gladi.

verses.text_en: Hear now these things and understand them, ye servants of the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Sada to čujte i razumijte, sluge Gospodnje.

verses.text_en: Behold, the word of the Lord, receive it: believe not the gods of whom the Lord spake.
verses.text_hr: Gle, riječ Gospodnju: primite je i ne vjerujte bogovima o kojima je Gospodin govorio.

verses.text_en: Behold, the plagues draw nigh, and are not slack.
verses.text_hr: Gle, pošasti se približavaju i ne posustaju.

verses.text_en: As when a woman with child in the ninth month bringeth forth her son, with two or three hours of her birth great pains compass her womb, which pains, when the child cometh forth, they slack not a moment:
verses.text_hr: Kao kad trudnici u devetome mjesecu, dva ili tri sata prije poroda, velike boli obuzmu utrobu i ne popuštaju ni trenutka kad dijete počne izlaziti,

verses.text_en: Even so shall not the plagues be slack to come upon the earth, and the world shall mourn, and sorrows shall come upon it on every side.
verses.text_hr: Tako i pošasti neće posustati da dođu na zemlju, i svijet će tugovati, a boli će ga stići sa svih strana.

verses.text_en: O my people, hear my word: make you ready to thy battle, and in those evils be even as pilgrims upon the earth.
verses.text_hr: O narode moj, poslušajte moju riječ: pripravite se za boj i u tim zlima budite poput putnika na zemlji.

verses.text_en: He that selleth, let him be as he that fleeth away: and he that buyeth, as one that will lose:
verses.text_hr: Tko prodaje, neka bude kao onaj koji bježi, a tko kupuje, kao onaj koji će izgubiti.

verses.text_en: He that occupieth merchandise, as he that hath no profit by it: and he that buildeth, as he that shall not dwell therein:
verses.text_hr: Tko trguje, neka bude kao onaj koji od toga nema koristi; tko gradi, kao onaj koji u tome neće stanovati.

verses.text_en: He that soweth, as if he should not reap: so also he that planteth the vineyard, as he that shall not gather the grapes:
verses.text_hr: Tko sije, kao da neće žeti; tko sadi vinograd, kao da neće brati grožđe.

verses.text_en: They that marry, as they that shall get no children; and they that marry not, as the widowers.
verses.text_hr: Oni koji se žene, kao da neće imati djece; oni koji se ne žene, kao da su udovci.

verses.text_en: And therefore they that labour labour in vain:
verses.text_hr: Zato se oni koji rade uzalud trude.

verses.text_en: For strangers shall reap their fruits, and spoil their goods, overthrow their houses, and take their children captives, for in captivity and famine shall they get children.
verses.text_hr: Stranci će žeti njihove plodove, pljačkati dobra, rušiti kuće i odvoditi im djecu u sužanjstvo, jer će djecu rađati u sužanjstvu i gladi.

verses.text_en: And they that occupy their merchandise with robbery, the more they deck their cities, their houses, their possessions, and their own persons:
verses.text_hr: A onima koji se u trgovini služe pljačkom — što više ukrašavaju svoje gradove, kuće, posjede i sebe,

verses.text_en: The more will I be angry with them for their sin, saith the Lord.
verses.text_hr: To ću se više ljutiti na njih zbog njihova grijeha, govori Gospodin.

verses.text_en: Like as a whore envieth a right honest and virtuous woman:
verses.text_hr: Kao što bludnica zavidi pravoj poštenoj i čestitoj ženi:

verses.text_en: So shall righteousness hate iniquity, when she decketh herself, and shall accuse her to her face, when he cometh that shall defend him that diligently searcheth out every sin upon earth.
verses.text_hr: Tako će pravednost zamrziti opačinu kada se ona okiti i optužiti je u lice kad dođe onaj koji će obraniti čovjeka koji pomno istražuje svaki grijeh na zemlji.

verses.text_en: And therefore be ye not like thereunto, nor to the works thereof.
verses.text_hr: Zato ne budite slični opačini ni njezinim djelima.

verses.text_en: For yet a little, and iniquity shall be taken away out of the earth, and righteousness shall reign among you.
verses.text_hr: Jer još malo, i opačina će biti uklonjena sa zemlje, a pravednost će zavladati među vama.

verses.text_en: Let not the sinner say that he hath not sinned: for God shall burn coals of fire upon his head, which saith before the Lord God and his glory, I have not sinned.
verses.text_hr: Neka grešnik ne kaže da nije sagriješio; Bog će nasuti užareno ugljevlje na glavu onomu koji pred Gospodinom Bogom i njegovom slavom kaže: Nisam sagriješio.

verses.text_en: Behold, the Lord knoweth all the works of men, their imaginations, their thoughts, and their hearts:
verses.text_hr: Gle, Gospodin poznaje sva ljudska djela, njihove nakane, misli i srca.

verses.text_en: Which spake but the word, Let the earth be made; and it was made: Let the heaven be made; and it was created.
verses.text_hr: On je samo izgovorio riječ: Neka nastane zemlja — i nastala je; neka nastane nebo — i bilo je stvoreno.

verses.text_en: In his word were the stars made, and he knoweth the number of them.
verses.text_hr: Njegovom su riječju zvijezde stvorene i on zna broj njihov.

verses.text_en: He searcheth the deep, and the treasures thereof; he hath measured the sea, and what it containeth.
verses.text_hr: On istražuje bezdan i blago njegovo; on je izmjerio more i ono što je u njemu.

verses.text_en: He hath shut the sea in the midst of the waters, and with his word hath he hanged the earth upon the waters.
verses.text_hr: Zatvorio je more usred voda i svojom riječju objesio je zemlju na vode.

verses.text_en: He spreadeth out the heavens like a vault; upon the waters hath he founded it.
verses.text_hr: Razapeo je nebesa poput svoda i utemeljio ih na vodama.

verses.text_en: In the desert hath he made springs of water, and pools upon the tops of the mountains, that the floods might pour down from the high rocks to water the earth.
verses.text_hr: U pustinji je načinio izvore vode i jezerca na vrhovima planina, da se bujice slijevaju s visokih stijena i natapaju zemlju.

verses.text_en: He made man, and put his heart in the midst of the body, and gave him breath, life, and understanding.
verses.text_hr: On je stvorio čovjeka i stavio njegovo srce usred tijela i dao mu dah, život i razum.

verses.text_en: Yea and the Spirit of Almighty God, which made all things, and searcheth out all hidden things in the secrets of the earth,
verses.text_hr: I Duh Boga Svemogućega, koji je sve stvorio, istražuje sve skriveno u tajnama zemlje.

verses.text_en: Surely he knoweth your inventions, and what ye think in your hearts, even them that sin, and would hide their sin.
verses.text_hr: On doista poznaje vaše nakane i misli vaših srca, pa i one koji griješe i žele sakriti svoj grijeh.

verses.text_en: Therefore hath the Lord exactly searched out all your works, and he will put you all to shame.
verses.text_hr: Zato je Gospodin temeljito istražio sva vaša djela i sve će vas posramiti.

verses.text_en: And when your sins are brought forth, ye shall be ashamed before men, and your own sins shall be your accusers in that day.
verses.text_hr: A kad se vaši grijesi iznesu, bit ćete posramljeni pred ljudima, i vaši će vlastiti grijesi biti vaši tužitelji u onaj dan.

verses.text_en: What will ye do? or how will ye hide your sins before God and his angels?
verses.text_hr: Što ćete učiniti? Ili kako ćete sakriti svoje grijehe pred Bogom i njegovim anđelima?

verses.text_en: Behold, God himself is the judge, fear him: leave off from your sins, and forget your iniquities, to meddle no more with them for ever: so shall God lead you forth, and deliver you from all trouble.
verses.text_hr: Gle, sâm je Bog sudac; bojte ga se. Ostavite svoje grijehe i zaboravite svoje opačine, da se više nikada njima ne bavite; tako će vas Bog izvesti i izbaviti iz svake nevolje.

verses.text_en: For, behold, the burning wrath of a great multitude is kindled over you, and they shall take away certain of you, and feed you, being idle, with things offered unto idols.
verses.text_hr: Gle, nad vama se razbuktao gorući gnjev velikoga mnoštva. Odvest će neke od vas i, dok budete bespomoćni, hraniti vas jelima žrtvovanima idolima.

verses.text_en: And they that consent unto them shall be had in derision and in reproach, and trodden under foot.
verses.text_hr: A oni koji pristanu na njih bit će izvrgnuti ruglu i poruzi i gaženi.

verses.text_en: For there shall be in every place, and in the next cities, a great insurrection upon those that fear the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Na svakome mjestu i u obližnjim gradovima nastat će velik ustanak protiv onih koji se boje Gospodina.

verses.text_en: They shall be like mad men, sparing none, but still spoiling and destroying those that fear the Lord.
verses.text_hr: Bit će poput pomahnitalih ljudi: nikoga neće štedjeti, nego će i dalje pljačkati i uništavati one koji se boje Gospodina.

verses.text_en: For they shall waste and take away their goods, and cast them out of their houses.
verses.text_hr: Opustošit će i odnijeti njihova dobra te ih izbaciti iz njihovih kuća.

verses.text_en: Then shall they be known, who are my chosen; and they shall be tried as the gold in the fire.
verses.text_hr: Tada će se poznati oni koji su moji izabranici; i bit će prokušani kao zlato u vatri.

verses.text_en: Hear, O ye my beloved, saith the Lord: behold, the days of trouble are at hand, but I will deliver you from the same.
verses.text_hr: Čujte, ljubljeni moji, govori Gospodin. Gle, blizu su dani nevolje, ali ja ću vas iz njih izbaviti.

verses.text_en: Be ye not afraid neither doubt; for God is your guide,
verses.text_hr: Ne bojte se i ne sumnjajte, jer Bog je vaš vodič,

verses.text_en: And the guide of them who keep my commandments and precepts, saith the Lord God: let not your sins weigh you down, and let not your iniquities lift up themselves.
verses.text_hr: I vodič onih koji čuvaju moje zapovijedi i odredbe, govori Gospodin Bog. Ne dajte da vas grijesi pritisnu niti da se vaše opačine uzdignu.

verses.text_en: Woe be unto them that are bound with their sins, and covered with their iniquities like as a field is covered over with bushes, and the path thereof covered with thorns, that no man may travel through!
verses.text_hr: Teško onima koji su okovani svojim grijesima i prekriveni svojim opačinama kao što je polje obraslo grmljem, a staza mu trnjem prekrivena, kojom nitko ne može proći!

verses.text_en: It is left undressed, and is cast into the fire to be consumed therewith.
verses.text_hr: Ostavljeno je neobrađeno i bačeno u oganj da u njemu izgori.
